steps.title: Create
steps.text: Pick a Thanksgiving game, or all of them.

steps.title: Settings
steps.text: Choose 100, 50 or 25 squares and set your price.

steps.title: Invite
steps.text: Share one link with your team, family or supporters.

steps.title: Enjoy
steps.text: Numbers get drawn and the grid tracks winners by quarter.

footnote: Free to create. We never touch the money.
